episode_summary: In this episode, Kristy Nakamura shares her journey of building a successful real estate business by focusing on niche markets, particularly military families. She emphasizes the importance of leveraging existing relationships and using AI tools to enhance efficiency. Kristy also discusses strategies like using seller credits to make homes more affordable in high-rate markets.
